name: Park Tower
insider_take: Rising above the elegant Retiro neighborhood, Park Tower Buenos Aires is a soaring beacon of sophistication where European grandeur meets the passionate soul of Argentina — all wrapped in the prestige of The Luxury Collection.
whats_special: Standing 19 stories tall overlooking Plaza San Martín, Park Tower is one of Buenos Aires' most iconic luxury landmarks. As part of Marriott's exclusive STARS program under The Luxury Collection, guests enjoy rare personalized perks and elite service that go well beyond the standard luxury experience. The hotel sits steps from the city's finest shopping on Avenida Álvear and is surrounded by stunning Belle Époque architecture — making it a perfect launchpad for exploring the "Paris of South America." The interiors feature rich wood paneling, marble finishes, and curated art that pay homage to Argentina's refined cultural heritage.
pro_tip: Request a suite with views facing Plaza San Martín — the sweeping panorama of the plaza's lush canopy trees framed against the city skyline is absolutely breathtaking, especially at golden hour.
dont_miss: Don't skip a visit to the hotel's renowned Park Tower Grill , celebrated for serving some of the finest Argentine beef in the city — a bold claim in a country famous for its steakhouses. While in the neighborhood, walk just a few blocks to the legendary Café Tortoni , Buenos Aires' oldest café dating back to 1858, or explore the grand Teatro Colón , one of the world's top five opera houses — both quintessential Buenos Aires experiences within easy reach.
pros: Prime location in Recoleta district near parks and cultural attractions
Spacious rooms and suites with city or park views
Full-service spa and fitness center with modern amenities
Multiple dining options including rooftop restaurant with panoramic views
cons: Building style may feel dated to some modern travelers
